scenes.heading: Cloud Manager Target
scenes.narration: Maven. Cloud Manager Target. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: By default, what does Cloud Manager harvest from the Maven build?
scenes.heading: Every package produced by the Maven build
scenes.body: Section 5 says that by default, Cloud Manager harvests every package produced by the Maven build.
scenes.narration: By default, what does Cloud Manager harvest from the Maven build? Every package produced by the Maven build. Section 5 says that by default, Cloud Manager harvests every package produced by the Maven build.

scenes.question: Why must ui.apps or ui.content not be deployed individually by Cloud Manager when all already embeds them?
scenes.heading: Because they would be installed twice
scenes.body: The speech explains that the all package already embeds the other packages, so if ui.apps or ui.content were also deployed individually, they would be installed twice.

scenes.question: What property value should package-producing projects except all set in the filevault-package-maven-plugin?
scenes.heading: cloudManagerTarget set to none
scenes.body: Section 5 says that every package-producing project except all adds properties with cloudManagerTarget set to none in the FileVault plugin configuration.
scenes.narration: What property value should package-producing projects except all set in the filevault-package-maven-plugin? cloudManagerTarget set to none. Section 5 says that every package-producing project except all adds properties with cloudManagerTarget set to none in the FileVault plugin configuration.

scenes.question: Which package is the only one Cloud Manager should deploy?
scenes.heading: all
scenes.body: The rule in the speech is explicit: all is the only package that Cloud Manager deploys.
scenes.narration: Which package is the only one Cloud Manager should deploy? all. The rule in the speech is explicit: all is the only package that Cloud Manager deploys.

scenes.question: Given an application deployment in Cloud Manager, how many AEM packages should compose that deployment artifact?
scenes.heading: A single AEM package
scenes.body: Section 5 says an application deployment must be composed of a single AEM package.
scenes.narration: Given an application deployment in Cloud Manager, how many AEM packages should compose that deployment artifact? A single AEM package. Section 5 says an application deployment must be composed of a single AEM package.

scenes.question: What should that single deployment package contain?
scenes.heading: Sub packages for code, configuration, and any baseline content the application needs
scenes.body: The speech says the single deployment package contains sub packages for everything the application needs: code, configuration, and any baseline content.
scenes.narration: What should that single deployment package contain? Sub packages for code, configuration, and any baseline content the application needs. The speech says the single deployment package contains sub packages for everything the application needs: code, configuration, and any baseline content.

scenes.question: A deployment installed ui.apps once through all and then again directly. Which rule from the speech was violated?
scenes.heading: Every package except all should set cloudManagerTarget to none
scenes.body: The lesson's rule is to deploy only all, while every other package-producing project sets cloudManagerTarget to none to avoid duplicate installation.
